sections.heading: Rajagiri Business School vs St Albert's College for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Rajagiri Business School if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #91, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹7 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Kochi.
Choose St Albert's College if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹8 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹75,000, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Kochi.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹3.75 lakh as a tuition figure for Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance at Rajagiri Business School. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹75,000 as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at St Albert's College. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Rajagiri Business School's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹7 LPA and a highest package of ₹11 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
St Albert's College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹8 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Rajagiri Business School is listed on our records with CAT, XAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
St Albert's College is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Kerala. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Rajagiri Business School's recorded ₹3.75 lakh or St Albert's College's ₹75,000 fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Rajagiri Business School or St Albert's College?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Rajagiri Business School and St Albert's College differ in more than one way: Rajagiri Business School has a recorded NIRF 2025 #91, and St Albert's College has no NIRF rank on this page.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Rajagiri Business School vs St Albert's College?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹3.75 lakh for Rajagiri Business School on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance; our records list ₹75,000 for St Albert's College on MBA Finance. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Rajagiri Business School and St Albert's College?
faqs.answer: Rajagiri Business School's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹7 LPA and a highest package of ₹11 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Rajagiri Business School and St Albert's College accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, XAT for Rajagiri Business School, and CAT for St Albert's College. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Rajagiri Business School and St Albert's College in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Kochi, Kerala. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
